_what: A known-good resting state, for use straight after a download when nothing has been commanded yet. Cheap to run and it catches a surprising amount: a block that never wired itself, a cover whose FB_init did not run, a queue that is not draining, an instance routed to nothing.

steps.label: every MQTT block wired itself on its first cyclic call - an instance whose body never runs is silently absent from Home Assistant, and nothing warns
no composed topic was silently truncated - IEC cuts an over-long CONCAT short with no error, and the only other symptom is an entity that never appears
cover timings came from FB_init at the declaration - T_UD's own default is 10s, so 20s is what proves FB_init actually ran
the collector's array interface is live and idle: 8 circuits, both wired ones closed, pump off
the publish queue is draining and has dropped nothing - pr = pw means empty, which is the whole meaning of the derived flags
